title: Positive multiplication kernels are finite
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero with decidable equality, and let W be a Weierstrass curve over k with W.Δ ≠ 0. For every natural number n > 0, the subtype {P : W.toAffine.Point // n • P = 0}, using the usual point-group operation and identity, is finite.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Finite {P : W.toAffine.Point // n • P = 0}
